scopeLabel: All 15 main and 15 SI pages independently read as text and actual page images. NaHTe preparation, MPA-CdTe synthesis, microwave GSH-AuNC synthesis, all eight hybrid-volume formulations, time optimization, storage series and all reported characterization controls are retained. Source ambiguities are explicit; no biological experiment or device fabrication is invented. Reference molecules/cells and morphology illustrations are not measured sample coordinates.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
